method: Exactly two successful profile-off runs before integration, then two after integration. Sequential execution; no additional warmups or omitted successful samples. Existing minified ES2022 browser harness, fresh browser context/runtime/CRS reader per invocation, same fixture, default-off digests. Existing internal WASM worker parallelism is unchanged. No competing test/benchmark. These are instrumented elapsed times, not uninstrumented timings or cold-cache measurements.
recovery: The old /tmp E2E fixture was removed by reboot. Reused persisted 207-placement JSON, W4 converted CRS, and W10 native preprocess. Converted archived selector 0xffffffff padding to signed -1 without changing wire bits. Two harness starts failed on missing fixture files before prove; preparation also required correcting a script path and selector JSON representation. None produced a prove timing or is counted as a successful run.
limits: Two samples per condition in before-before-after-after order do not establish statistical significance or isolate each candidate. Per-worker task details remain in ignored local results; committed evidence preserves all elapsed stage samples, operation counters, MSM calls, and aggregated task counters.
